Agent-guided creative code and inspectable scene models extend beyond text-to-image generation. External model execution is a separate dependency.
Compared branching visual-agent workflows and interactive educational scenes. Documentation is evidence of intended behavior, not a hands-on performance test.
CAD and pottery workflows were reviewed. STEP/STL export and paper templates are not proof of manufacturability.
OpenGame and Evoke extend the search to game/world creation. Complete software and weight terms were not established for those web findings.
Motion generation and capture remain separate from animation authoring. LODGE++ supplies a primary research comparison; model downloads need their own permissions.
SVG character chat and new avatar clients were inspected. Character artwork permissions remain separate from open application code.
Surveyed relighting and compositing with official project pages. No production-readiness verdict follows from a paper demo alone.
SonoWorld documents image-guided spatial sound scene generation. Its full release/license and reproduction review is still pending.
Reviewed reconstruction and holographic visualization guides; synthetic checks do not validate real-capture accuracy.
FrameShift, TakeBoard and agent-guided editors broaden the practical editing paths. Subtitle Edit remains a relevant source for current transcription/OCR integration.
SVG Generator has an AI image stage followed by vectorization. Vector tracing alone is not evidence of AI relevance.
VecGlypher documents editable vector-glyph generation. This primary-source finding still needs a complete release/license review before library eligibility.

Reviewed accessible-book and slide publishing. Separate source/media rights and provider dependencies are retained in the guides.
CCRaw, Alcedo and newly surfaced RAW editors cover local photographic work. Packaging and model support are checked per platform, without inferring cross-platform parity.
Vistep documents AI-assisted interactive explanations. Scientific visualization candidates need explicit model limitations and factual review.
Fugleramme turns local bird-audio classification into a changing illustrated display. This expands installation discovery beyond image generators.
Checked neural instrument processing and speech/character performance tools. The GitLab amp project remains relevant but was not repeated without a verified change.
PatternGSL and EasyFashion were found through primary research pages. Software release and complete licensing remain unresolved here; neither is promoted to a vetted tool.
ADT Studio and mobile speech tools document creative accessibility uses. Generated alt text, translation and narration still require human review.
F-Droid documents Muse’s Android requirements and non-free ElevenLabs dependency. An open client does not make its hosted inference open source.
Vistep and ADT provide distinct explanation and publication workflows. Browser/reading-order checks were documented, not executed.
Reviewed score recovery, restoration and pottery-documentation sources. Preserve originals and inspect AI-produced detail rather than treating it as historical evidence.
Continued beyond the starter fields to olfactory interaction, robotic painting, ceramics and holographic visualization. Unreleased or unlicensed findings remain watchlist items.
HapticGen and HapticMatch provide primary research on multimodal haptic generation. No newly licensed, installable release was confirmed from these pages.
Compared spatial-sound generation with neural-acoustic research. Papers and datasets are not automatically creator-ready applications.
Gaido, TakeBoard and other reviewed projects give agents explicit media operations. Model/service requirements and output review stay visible.
Strike a Chord documents semantic kinetic typography, but its page says code is coming. It remains an unresolved release finding.
Reviewed ChoreoMuse, InfiniteDance and AtomicDance project pages. InfiniteDance’s non-commercial research restriction prevents treating it as open-source software here.
Expanded into slab pottery, ceramic documentation and robotic forming. Computational geometry alone is not sufficient; selected tools must expose a concrete AI contribution.
Revisited the existing oemer guide for image-to-MusicXML recognition; no meaningful update justified repeating it. Missing license evidence keeps Starry outside the eligible library.
Reviewed RelightAnime alongside Relit-LiVE and virtual-production relighting sources. A publication or convincing demo does not establish complete software/model permissions.
AromaGen and Smell with Genji show AI scent interaction and games. No complete open-source software release was established in this pass.
RoomSmith and floor-plan model cards broaden interior/layout research. Exact software, model and downstream design permissions remain separate checks.
Reviewed holographic-display research and G2LF. G2LF’s explicit non-commercial software terms exclude it from the open-source library.
Neural Puppet provides primary context for layer-based character motion. The older paper is not described as a new software release.

Unfolded adds agent-assisted slab templates. The October PyPottery paper extends coverage to AI-supported digitization and publication; classical companion modules are not independently labeled AI tools.
Reviewed Cadjitsu and Unfolded’s explicit agent interfaces, plus architectural generation sources. Human dimensional review remains necessary.
CartoAgent and map-making research remain relevant; Kartogen’s author explicitly distinguishes it from AI world generation, so it is excluded from AI eligibility.
IMPASTO documents learned robotic oil painting and physical failure cases. The page did not establish an available licensed code release.
New field added before collection. ToonComposer provides controllable cartoon inbetweening and colorization with substantial documented GPU demand.
New field added before collection. ControlFoley, its official ComfyUI nodes and FoleyCrafter have detailed guides. MultiFoley remains a source finding pending release/license checks.
